exact_statement: Version9 retains the prior scoped clauses and adds: for every finite-label selector L(Y) independent of shared data X, arbitrary Boolean sources g_j, and original support-positive source references R_j inherited through EACH source own physical phase kernel, let pi=law(L), q=sum pi P_j, r=sum pi R_j, W=sum pi D(P_j||R_j), alpha_j=pi_j P_j/q, rho_j=pi_j R_j/r, and k(U|t)=Pf(U,t)/q_t. For ANY history-adapted stochastic K_t(U|j) with alpha K=k, prescribe Q(U,t)=r_t(rho K)(U), completing zero-true rows at empty U. Then D(Pf||Q)=D(q||r)+C, C=sum q D(alpha K||rho K)<=Z=W-D(q||r), S=W-D(Pf||Q)>=0. W is a supermartingale under all physical DATA/CONTROL restrictions. Every finite adaptive mixed stopping tree obeys sum reach*(E Dchild-Dparent) +sum reach*(Wparent-E Wchild)+E Sleaf=Sroot, and the FULL entropy path plus full terminal CE equals Hroot+Wroot-sum reach*(Wparent-E Wchild)-E Sleaf<=Hroot+Wroot. For binary muxes whose nonempty controller SHAPE has already changed via the original inherited Ra of v8, admissible sector odds ell=rho*u+(1-rho)*v with alpha*u+(1-alpha)*v=b add C=sum q D(Bern(b)||Bern(ell))<=Zdata to D8; SAME original T=Wdata+gamma D(Pa||Ra) suffices and S9=Zdata-C+gamma Cvac>=0, with the same exact mixed-tree identity and no new liability or rate constant. Transport CURRENT Q through the actual output channel; raw reset equals signed debt increment plus actual erasure/outcome refunds. Both full terminal bills, vacuum KL, actual reference outcome normalizers, off-target mass and all previous debits remain. Exact admissible binary odds are the affine image of tau in [max(0,alpha+b-1),min(alpha,b)]. A Boolean odds-only witness with a=(-1,1,1,1), G=z,H=-z and dummy data d has H=I=2, W=Da=Z=0, alpha=rho=b=3/4; prescribed ell=1/2 costs (1/4)log2(27/16)>0 and lies outside the admissible image, refuting arbitrary odds-only payment from a tight quota but not FEI.
